digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows, main branch CI reporting
propositions: Push to main triggers cancellation of prior runs in the same concurrency group, rendering healthy main as red X on GitHub despite passing pre-merge Verified gate.

Six workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml) currently trigger on push to main; this must be removed by adding main to branches-ignore or dropping push trigger entirely.

Three cheap workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml) must gain 6-hourly scheduled runs at staggered off-the-hour minutes (41, 47, 53) to replace per-commit attribution with periodic main health signal.
Scheduled and dispatched test.yml runs must resolve last-known-green SHA from Actions API and emit copy-pasteable git bisect recipe with both bad and good SHAs to job summary on failure.
All six workflows must retain or gain workflow_dispatch for on-demand health checks; external-integration.yml stays weekly; gerrit-verify.yaml and reconcilers remain unchanged.
